doc: A rock material: everything that makes granite granite, from its shape and surface to its colours and how it breaks. Materials are data (the workspace's config/rock_materials/).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name, e.g. Granite.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What it is, geologically (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, volcanic glass, ...).

fields.name: facets
fields.doc: Flat faces the rock is chiselled from: few for blocky, many for rounded.

fields.name: roundness
fields.doc: How far the facets are worn round, as water and weather do (0 = sharp, 1 = a river cobble).

fields.name: elongation
fields.doc: Length over width.

fields.name: flatness
fields.doc: Height over width (slabs are low).

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Surface relief, as a fraction of the rock's size.

fields.name: relief_scale
fields.doc: Size of the surface relief's lumps, as a fraction of the rock's size (small is grainy).

fields.name: fracture
fields.doc: How it breaks: voronoi chunks, slab plates along its layers, columnar prisms, splinter shards, crumble into many small pieces, impact (fine near the blow, coarse away), or split into a few halves.

fields.name: pieces
fields.doc: Pieces a medium rock breaks into; smaller rocks break into fewer, larger into more.

fields.name: grain
fields.doc: The fracture's preferred direction (layers' normal for slabs, the long axis for splinters and columns), in rock space before its random turn.

fields.name: grain_strength
fields.doc: How strongly pieces follow the grain (0 = not at all).

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: Surface pattern: plain, speckled (granite's crystals), banded (sandstone's strata), veined (marble), layered (slate's cleavage), jointed (basalt's columns), glassy (obsidian's sheen), or pitted (limestone).

fields.name: pattern_scale
fields.doc: Size of the pattern's features, metres.

fields.name: color_light
fields.doc: Main colour on high and weathered surfaces, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: color_dark
fields.doc: Main colour in hollows, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: accent
fields.doc: Pattern colour: crystals, bands, veins, or sheen, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: fresh
fields.doc: Colour of a freshly broken face, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: lichen
fields.doc: How readily moss and lichen take on it (porous rock more), scaling the request's moss.

fields.name: moss_color
fields.doc: Moss colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: snow
fields.doc: How much snow settles on it in winter.

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Density, g/cm3: heavier pieces fly less far.
